_comment: SYNTHETIC, against FORECAST_SCHEMA plus the live-confirmed fields the SDK's bundled schema does not declare (P24, decision-log D-45): `organization` (a real nested hierarchy), `modified`/`created`, and `primary_contact` as a structured object rather than the plain string the SDK's own type claims. Note what the provider still does NOT model on a forecast even after that finding: no anticipated solicitation date, no PSC, no estimated value, no source URL. The fixture records those absences rather than inventing the fields. Row 2 exercises full-shape-present-but-null (organization/primary_contact both explicitly null); row 3 exercises the fields being entirely ABSENT from the raw record, the case a real minimal-shape response could produce.
